verification.live_remote_reports: War Effort 1.6.x and HeadHunter as a member, the Spy family and three guild incident addons read-only, LEGW1 own sightings and relays; shown as reported, not confirmed
verification.ask_for_invite: Single-host hops remain one request; hop-any clicks query WHO once with UI suppressed, consider 49 rows, use at most 8 attempts/round at 1 s for 45 rounds, 10 s between clicks; retry throttled heads and re-ask unknown same-zone hosts once at +3/+10 s; guild requests stay player-sent
verification.auto_accept_leave: On by default, saved: accepts only the asked host invite (120 s, not grouped/instance/combat), leaves only that group 3 s after the move or 30 s without one
verification.guild_host: Off until turned on, then saved (guildHost boolean, ON line at login); guild members only, guild name readable and unchanged; at most one InviteUnit per request, 10 s apart, 6 per 600 s; never in combat; refused beside LayerSwap or Bulo
verification.networks: Public by default (first-login line once); /le net guild|public, per-network switches, /le share on|off, window switches
verification.sends: LayerSwap/WHISPER, LEGW1/GUILD (including K1 own-death, share switch, 1/120s and 5/30min), LFSw/GUILD Q, WEFF1 (GUILD, PARTY, RAID, WHISPER) and HeadHunter/WHISPER behind Net (both shipped on; /le net guild stops public scope); FLHNET2 HI on GUILD/PARTY/RAID, WR/CA/WP/LQ/LR on WHISPER through Wire, no hosting or channel sends
verification.visual_design: Approved B implemented with fourth Find tab; native client appearance unverified
